headline: Without State Support, Large Enterprises May Move to Mass Shutdowns – Federation of Metallurgists
summary: The Federation of Metallurgists warns large enterprises could move to mass shutdowns without state industrial support, and calls for a relaunch of support policy.
why: Steel and metals producers are major employers and exporters, so shutdowns would affect industrial output and export revenues.
